name: Test Valley Borough Revised Local Plan (2011 - 2029)

housing-numbers.notes: Total requirement split: Northern Test Valley 7,092 (394 per annum), Southern Test Valley 3,492 (194 per annum). Allocated housing includes strategic allocations: Whitenap 1,300, Picket Piece 400, Picket Twenty extension 300, Hoe Lane 300, Stoneham 50, George Yard 100. Committed housing includes completions plus existing commitments. Windfall assumptions: Northern 490, Southern 224.
